response.sql:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) as byte_rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
overall_avg_byte_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as avg_byte_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
),
filtered_media_types AS (
  SELECT
    mts.avg_unit_price,
    mts.byte_rate,
    oabr.avg_byte_rate
  FROM media_type_stats mts
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_byte_rate oabr
  WHERE mts.byte_rate > oabr.avg_byte_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(byte_rate) as avg_of_byte_rates,
  AVG(byte_rate - avg_byte_rate) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_media_types;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from both the average unit price and byte rate calculation for each media type. Only media types with at least one track having a non-NULL Bytes value are included in the final result.

alternatives.interpretation: Only the byte rate calculation excludes tracks with NULL Bytes; the average unit price is calculated across all tracks in the media type (not just those with non-NULL Bytes), but the media type must still have at least one track with non-NULL Bytes to be included overall.
alternatives.sql:
WITH media_type_price AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
media_type_bytes AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) as byte_rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.MediaTypeId,
    p.avg_unit_price,
    b.byte_rate
  FROM media_type_price p
  INNER JOIN media_type_bytes b ON p.MediaTypeId = b.MediaTypeId
),
overall_avg_byte_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as avg_byte_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
),
filtered_media_types AS (
  SELECT
    mts.avg_unit_price,
    mts.byte_rate,
    oabr.avg_byte_rate
  FROM media_type_stats mts
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_byte_rate oabr
  WHERE mts.byte_rate > oabr.avg_byte_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(byte_rate) as avg_of_byte_rates,
  AVG(byte_rate - avg_byte_rate) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_media_types;
